name: facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/src/common/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with a config object to prepare model training with Adam optimizer
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.run_Trainer_make_model: run the Trainer _make_model method to build a DataParallel model and optimizer for training
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.test_Trainer_set_lr: test the Trainer set_lr method to adjust learning rate based on epoch and decay schedule
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.build_Tester: build a Tester instance with config and test epoch to load a model checkpoint for evaluation
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.run_Tester_evaluate: run the Tester _evaluate method to evaluate predictions against the test dataset

facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.create_colorlogger: create a colorlogger instance that writes colored logs to a directory and console
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.log_info_message: log an info message with a green timestamp to both file and console
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.log_warning_message: log a warning message with a yellow WRN prefix to both file and console
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.log_error_message: log an error message with a red ERR prefix to both file and console
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.log_critical_message: log a critical message with a red CRI prefix to both file and console

facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance to track elapsed time for benchmarking code execution
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.start_timer_with_tic: start the Timer by calling tic to record the current start time
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.stop_timer_with_toc: stop the Timer by calling toc to get elapsed time or average time
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.get_average_elapsed_time: get the average elapsed time across multiple tic/toc calls after warmup period
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/s.get_single_elapsed_time: get the single elapsed time diff by calling toc with average set to False
